ledger.x: c. 3100 BCE: the Norte Chico civilisation of the Supe, Pativilca and Fortaleza valleys takes shape. Large-scale settlement is 'clearly apparent' from 3100 BCE (lead; 3200 BCE in the body; the first city about 3500 BCE at Huaricanga); the Caral page has Caral developing between 3000 and 1800 BC and built c. 2600 BC.

c. 1800 BCE: the civilisation declines. 'The civilization began to decline c. 1800 BCE, as more powerful centers emerged elsewhere on the coast and in the Andes'; the Caral page says Caral was abandoned c. 2000 BC and a 2025 study links its abandonment to a drought around 2200 BCE. About a thousand years pass before…
